name: scc
description: Fast and accurate code counter with complexity calculation and multiple output formats

tools.description: Sloc, Cloc and Code complexity counter with support for 200+ programming languages
tools.usage:
scc . # Count lines in current directory
scc --by-file src/ # Show per-file statistics
scc --format json . # JSON output format
scc --exclude-dir node_modules,vendor . # Exclude directories
scc --sort complexity . # Sort by complexity
